course.title: DSA Patterns That Transfer
course.subtitle: Recognise the shape, not the question
course.summary: The recurring patterns behind interview problems and real work, covering linear structures, recursion, trees, graphs and dynamic programming.
overview: Grinding hundreds of problems teaches you hundreds of problems. Learning the twenty or so patterns underneath them teaches you the next problem you have not seen.
This course is organised by pattern rather than by data structure, because that is how problems present themselves in an interview and in a profiler trace.
whatYouWillLearn: Identify which pattern a problem belongs to before writing code
Analyse time and space complexity without memorising tables
Apply two pointers, sliding window and prefix sums confidently
Work through recursion and backtracking systematically
Handle tree and graph traversal problems by shape
Move from recursive brute force to dynamic programming step by step
Communicate your reasoning the way interviewers expect

curriculum.title: Foundations
lessons: Arrays, strings and the hidden costs

audience: Engineers preparing for product company interviews
Self-taught developers filling gaps in fundamentals
Anyone who has solved many problems and still feels unprepared for new ones
prerequisites: Comfortable writing code in Java or a similar language
Basic familiarity with arrays, maps and recursion
